# User Documentation

---

# User Story 1 (Piper)

#### “As a user of the app, I want to create an account so that I can place food orders”

To create an account, click on “**account**” from the top right-hand side of the website homepage.  On this page, users must provide their first name, last name, email address, phone number, password, and password confirmation (see below).

![][image1] 

# User Story 2 (Piper)

#### “As a user of the app, I want to browse nearby restaurants”

On the homepage, scroll down to “Find the Right Restaurant Fast”. The “All distances” dropdown box gives customers the ability to search within a specified distance (see red circle below). Click “search” and the results will be displayed.

![][image2]

# User Story 3 (Piper)

#### “As a user of the app, I want to filter restaurants by rating”

Scroll down the main homepage until you find “**Restaurant Results**”.The restaurant cards indicate the type of food, and also has a user star rating (see below with the red arrows). This information is displayed from this screen and also on customized searches. 

![][image3]

# User Story 4 (Jack)

#### “As a user of the app, I want to edit or remove items from the cart”

The user can add items to their cart at any time by clicking the green “Add to Cart” button located beneath each menu item. Once selected, the item will appear on the right-hand side of the screen in the “Your Cart” section.

To remove all items, the user can click the green “Clear Cart” button located at the bottom of the cart, below the pricing and promo code section.

![][image4]

# User Story 5 (Terry)

#### “As a user of the app, I want to filter restaurants by cuisine”

Users can search for different cuisine types in the first search bar text box such as “**Mexican, Indian, Italian** or **Asain**”, and if our website has any appropriate restaurants that match the search query then they will display them on the restaurants results section of the search page.

![][image5]  
![][image6]

# User Story 6 (Terry)

#### “As a user of the app, I want to apply promo codes”

Users can apply any current promo codes to get a small discount on the total of their orders, Users can see the “**openingspecial**” promo code is already inside the promo text box under their order breakdown on the left side of the menu page. All the user has to do is click “**Apply**” and the promo will be activated for this order. 

![][image7]

# User Story 7 (Terry)

#### “As a user of the app, I want to search for gluten-free only food”

To search for gluten-free food, you need to either click on the green “Feed Me Now” button or scroll down to the search filters just above where the restaurants are listed. Find the filter that says “All Dietary Options” and click on the drop down menu which has an option called “Gluten-Free”. This will display all the restaurants that offer gluten free food.

![][image8]

# User Story 8 (Jack)

#### “As a user of the app, I want to have a secure login”

Users can be assured that their FeedMe account is secure, as it is protected by a password they create during registration. This password is not stored in plain text; instead, it is securely hashed before being saved, ensuring that sensitive information cannot be easily accessed or read. The system leverages Amazon services to store and manage this data, providing an additional layer of reliability and security. Together, these measures help protect user accounts from unauthorized access and ensure that personal information remains safe.

![][image9]

# User Story 9 (Ben)

#### “As a user of the app, I want to view restaurant menus so that I can decide what to order”

There are two ways in which customers can view restaurant menus within the feedme platform. The first is via the search function on the homepage under “**Find the Right Restaurant Fast**”. This search option allows customers to enter custom data into the data fields and display the results. From here you click on the “**view menu**” button for that restaurant (see below).

![][image10]

# 

The second option is to scroll down until you find “**Featured Food Item**s”. The restaurants listed below this title are the options available in our services. Each restaurant has a “**show menu**” button (see below).

![][image11]

# User Story 10 (Ben)

#### “As a user of the app, I want to pay with a debit or credit card so that I can complete my purchase”

The customer must have an account with FeedMe to use this feature. Once logged into the account and the desired food is chosen, go to the right-hand side of the screen. Under the “**checkout**” is a “**Payment Method**” dropdown box. Choose “**Eftpos on delivery**”.

![][image12]

# User Story 11(Ben)

#### “As a user of the app, I want to enter my delivery address so that my food arrives correctly”

The customer must have an account with FeedMe and a saved address within the system to use this feature. Open “**Account**” from the top right hand side of the website. If there are no addresses under “**Saved Addresses**“, a valid address needs to be entered under the “**Update Details**” section and saved (see below).  
![][image13]

# User Story 12 (Jack)

#### “As a User of the app, I want to search for restaurants so that I can quickly find them”

Users can search for restaurants by entering keywords into the search bar located on the left-hand side of the screen, beneath the main menu call-to-action. In addition to keyword searches, users can apply various filtering options to refine their results. Once a search or filter is applied, the matching restaurants will be displayed below the rotating restaurant gallery, allowing users to easily browse relevant options.

![][image14]  
![][image15]

# User Story 13 (Lachlan)

#### “As a user of the app, I want to view order histories so that I can quickly reorder previous meals and keep track of his past purchases”

To view your order history, you first need to place multiple orders. To place an order you either click the large green “**Feed Me Now**” button on the home page, which will take you to all the available restaurants or you can scroll down the home page to view the restaurants. Once you decide on a restaurant, click “**Show Menu**”. Then you decide on what food and drinks you want by clicking “**Add to Cart**”. Once you’ve decided on what food/drink you want, proceed to the checkout which is displayed on the right hand side of the Menu pages.Fill in your details and click on “**Place Order**.” Now repeat these steps to create multiple orders. Once done, you go to the “**My Orders**” heading at the top and there you will see your orders you’ve placed under “**Current Order**” and all the previous orders will be under “**Previous Orders**.” To quickly reorder previous meals to keep track of past purchases, there is a green button under the order in previous orders that says “**Reorder Previous Order**,” when clicked the order for Previous Orders will go to Current Order.

![][image16]

# User Story 14 (Lachlan)

#### “As a user of the app, I want to select between pickup and delivery”

When checking out, you need to choose your order type: Pickup or Delivery. To do this, choose the restaurant you want and click “**Show Menu**”. After that, select your food and drinks by adding them to your cart. When you proceed to checkout, you will see Order Type with two options: Pickup (Free) or Deliver ($5.00).  
![][image17]

# User Story 15 (Lachlan)

#### “As a user of the app, I want to receive order confirmation notifications so that I can make sure my order was successfully placed and is being processed”

To enable notifications for your orders, you need to choose what restaurant you want and click “**Show Menu**”. After that, select your food and drinks by adding them to your cart. When you proceed to checkout, you will see a heading called “**Notifications**”, which includes a checkbox that says “**Send me text message updates about my order**”. When you placed an order it says SMS notifications with it saying enabled or not enabled depending on if you clicked the checkbox or not.
